54/S0.subgoal: Explain the different types of optimization in XR and the specific focus on resource optimization.

54/S1.subgoal: Identify various types of resources and justify focusing on client-end hardware for optimization.

54/S2.subgoal: Explain why high-quality hardware is needed by introducing the role of computer graphics in rendering.

54/S3.subgoal: Describe basic concepts of computer graphics, including how images are represented and synthesized.

54/S4.subgoal: Describe the components of a generic graphics system and their roles in rendering.

54/S5.subgoal: Compare vector scan and raster scan devices and explain the concept of a frame buffer.

54/S6.subgoal: Explain the need for screen refreshing and the importance of refresh rates in VR.

54/S7.subgoal: Describe how color is perceived on digital displays.
